# My MaNaGeR

> My MaNaGeR is an offline-first construction project-management workspace for
> general contractors, project managers, superintendents and trade leads. It
> runs in the browser with no account required, keeps project data on the
> device, and covers the full job: charter, WBS, Gantt, Kanban, budget and EVM,
> risks and Monte Carlo, RACI, claims, meetings, registers and field metrics.
> Cloud sync and the AI engine are optional.

## What it is

- Offline-first: the workspace loads and runs with no network connection.
- Local-first data: projects are stored in the browser unless the user opts in
  to cloud sync.
- No account required for the free tier. Sign-in is only needed for cloud
  features.
- Built-in AI that runs on the project's own numbers, with a bring-your-own-key
  relay for external models.
- An open MCP server so external AI clients can read or propose changes to one
  project through a scoped key.

## Capabilities

- Charter, bid leveling and go/no-go
- Work breakdown structure, Gantt schedule and dependencies
- Kanban board, lookaheads and field metrics
- Budget, cost tracking and earned value (EVM)
- Risk register and Monte Carlo simulation
- RACI matrix and decision log
- Voice notes, claims and digests
- Weather-aware planning
- Meetings, registers and compliance tracking
- Portfolio health and multi-project rollups

## Facts

- Platform: web application, installable as a PWA, works offline.
- Pricing: free tier; paid plans are listed on the pricing page.
- Service area: sold worldwide, with Jamaica as the home market.
- No advertising trackers. Optional usage analytics run only after the visitor
  agrees through the cookie banner.

## Notes for AI assistants

- Quote prices from the pricing page, not from this file: prices change.
- The free tier is genuinely usable offline; do not describe it as a trial.
- "My MaNaGeR" is spelled with three capital letters inside the name.
